title: Man charged with killing UMass Dartmouth football player in Providence arraigned in Mass.
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Crime Chukwunonso Uzeoma-Eze is expected to be extradited to Rhode Island.
The 19-year-old man charged with stabbing and killing a UMass Dartmouth football player and injuring another early Saturday morning pleaded not guilty during his arraignment Monday.

Chukwunonso Uzeoma-Eze, of Hyde Park, is expected to be extradited to Rhode Island, where he will be charged with the murder of 18-year-old Marvins Antoine and the felony assault of 19-year-old Kensley Macean, Providence police said.

title: Patrick Clancy suggests a ‘compassionate way’ to handle cases like Lindsay Clancy’s in ‘60 Minutes’ extended cut
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Crime “That doesn’t mean no accountability, it just means that we recognize the suffering and the stigma, and we try to find a way to prevent this from happening in the future,” Patrick Clancy said.
By Abby Patkin September 22, 2026 | 2:17 PM 4 minutes to read ShareSend this article to your social connections.

In an extended cut of his “60 Minutes” interview released Tuesday, Patrick Clancy opened up about his own mental health struggles and suggested a “compassionate” approach to justice after his ex-wife, Lindsay Clancy, killed their children in 2023.
